column5: Use your double jump when within the final 10-15% of the confirm
Using your doublejump between frame 7-8 after inputting jump will give you the maximum available jumping speed, after that it's all up to the up b input
1-2% into the confirm will kill even with DI on the Up b
DI Out affects positioning and slightly reduces the top of the confirm range by 3-4%, and reduces the minimum confirm range by 1-2%
DI In can be hit with a reverse Uair > Bair (even up b if your positioning is correct)
Shorter stages, such as Final Destination, the confirm will kill 3% earlier
